configurePresets.name: linux-app
configurePresets.description: Full native stack on Linux. Needs X11/PipeWire dev packages, aubio, OpenCV, libcurl, Mbed TLS.

configurePresets.name: windows-app
configurePresets.description: Full native stack on Windows (MSVC, Windows SDK for DXGI; OpenCV for core).

configurePresets.name: mac-app
configurePresets.description: Full native stack on macOS. AURORA_ENABLE_INPUT_MAC/AURORA_ENABLE_APP_MAC stay OFF until input/mac and app/mac exist (Aurora-8mk.2/.3) -- flip to ON here once they do. Until then this preset only confirms the toolchain/shared libraries (core/, output/hue/) configure cleanly on Darwin.
